en.title: Jr. Frontend Developer
en.stack: JavaScript, React, jQuery, PHP, Node.js, MySQL, WordPress, HTML/CSS

items: Analyzed new client requirements and built websites and landing pages focused on conversion, with attention to SEO, responsiveness and performance.
Adapted the sites as client needs changed.
Worked with HTML/CSS, JavaScript, jQuery and React on the front end, and with PHP, Node.js, MySQL and WordPress on the back end.
